name: Cat’s Eyes
body:
School transmutation; Level cleric/oracle 2, druid 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range personal or touch
Target you or one creature touched
Duration 1 min./level
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

You confer low-light vision on yourself or on one creature touched.

Low-light vision allows the subject (or yourself) to see objects twice as far away under bright or shadowy illumination.
